name: Rust Engineer Pack
description: Workflows for coding agents building production Rust: ownership and lifetime patterns, idiomatic error handling, async with Tokio, safe unsafe abstractions, and Clippy hygiene.
useCases: Write idiomatic Rust with sound ownership, lifetime, and trait design.
Build async services with Tokio and design safe abstractions over unsafe code.
Clean up error handling and Clippy warnings across a Rust codebase.
examplePrompts: Refactor this module to fix the borrow-checker fights with idiomatic ownership patterns instead of clones.
Review this unsafe block and wrap it in a safe, documented abstraction with tests.
